title: [maintainer] queue directory not validated at startup
description: Config validation (config.rs) checks relay peer host/port/auth but does NOT validate that smtp_relay_queue_dir is writable or creatable. SmtpRelayQueue::new() calls fs::create_dir_all() but returns std::io::Error if it fails. This error is not caught during server startup. Operator won't discover the problem until first article is posted and enqueue fails. Need: add config validation step that attempts create_dir_all on startup and fails fast with clear error message.
